reviewFlags.issue: The Israeli retailer page for HY-NRK6192SYW (SKU 942138) describes a 120 cm integrated two-unit pair: 121 × 185.5 × 60 cm, built-in niche 125 × 187 × 68 cm, rated 640 L for two connected units. The catalog says 60 × 185 × 59.2 cm, single 302 L unit. The 60 cm figure comes only from a Serbian retailer. Confirm which configuration is sold as NRK6192SYW before publishing dimensions, capacity or features.
The 640 L figure on the Israeli page is for two connected units, not the 302 L single unit in the catalog. The 302 L, 203 L and 99 L figures come from a single Serbian retailer page only.
